title: CatzMeowMC
description: Replaces cats sounds from minecraft with sounds of cats from game Catz 5!
body:
# CatzMeowMC
Hear your cats again but in Minecraft with this resource pack! It **replaces** all cats sounds from Minecraft with cats sounds from the game Catz 5. This pack will appeal not only to fans of the Catz game but also to anyone who wants fresh, fitting sounds for their cats!

# What edited?
All sounds of cats from Minecraft was replaced! Cats sounds includes:
- meows
- purrmeows
- purring
- hissing
- stray cat meows sounds (they're different from domesticated ones!)
- stray cat begging sounds
- damage and death sounds for all cats
- and even eating sounds.
> Ocelot's sounds wasn't changed!

### What cats breedz sounds from Catz 5 was used?
It's mixed with different breeds sounds, but mostly it's a tabby!

# How it works?
- In this resource pack, every Minecraft cat sound has been removed and replaced with a sound of cats from the Catz game. This not included ocelot's sounds.
- Nothing else has been changed or edited.
- It does not require any mods or other resource packs.
- It is compatible with other resource packs. If another pack also replaces cat sounds, this pack will only work if it is placed higher in the resource pack list.
- If any mod triggers a cat sound, it will typically play the sound from this resource pack.
